consolidation_policy: All imported source objects and references are retained. Exact projects share an existing project; phases remain separate projects at shared sites. Multi-site programs and unresolved identities stay in downloadable source records without being counted as physical sites.
observation_policy: Last documented observations; records are not a claim that all projects are still under construction on the update date.
withdrawal_note: Unsupported construction selections are removed; no cancellation or other physical status is inferred.
